 AI reshapes holiday shopping as PH consumers shift search habits 
 Close menu 
 November 20, 2026 
 11:26AM PHT
 Holiday shopping 
 Truelogic 
 Artificial Intelligence 
 Share
 Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how Filipino consumers shop for Christmas gifts, creating new challenges for retailers and e-commerce businesses as product discovery increasingly shifts from traditional search engines to AI-generated recommendations.
 Instead of browsing multiple websites, shoppers can now use AI tools to discover gift ideas, compare prices, evaluate product features and narrow their choices through conversational queries. 
 For businesses, this means securing a prominent position in conventional search results may no longer guarantee visibility among potential customers. 
 Changing landscape 
 A 12-month study by digital marketing agency Truelogic, covering 80 brands across seven sectors, found that mentions of Philippine brands in Google AI Overviews surged more than 23-fold between January and December 2025. 
 Retail, e-commerce and real estate recorded the strongest growth in AI visibility. 
 Meanwhile, the Digital 2026 Global Overview Report by We Are Social and Meltwater, citing GWI data, showed that 42.4 percent of surveyed Filipino internet users aged 16 and above had used ChatGPT in the previous month. 
 The Philippines ranked sixth among the markets surveyed, with usage particularly strong among younger consumers. 
 Retail implications 
 Although the studies did not directly measure holiday purchases, their findings suggest that AI-powered recommendations are becoming an important part of the consumer buying journey, Truelogic said in a statement. 
 Shoppers can increasingly compare prices, product specifications, reviews and availability before visiting retailer websites. 
 For brands, inaccurate or incomplete product information could mean missing out on AI-generated shopping recommendations. 
 Truelogic said businesses must ensure their digital content is accessible, credible and structured to answer consumer questions. 
 Boosting visibility 
 To help businesses adapt, Truelogic introduced its PROOF Framework, which evaluates AI search readiness across five areas: Platforms, Retrieval, Organization, Originality and Footprint. 
 The framework encourages businesses to maintain accurate information across websites and third-party platforms, organize content around customer questions, publish original insights and monitor how AI tools describe their brands. 
 These measures complement traditional search engine optimization, digital advertising and customer engagement strategies. 
 Long-term strategy 
 “As we enter the busiest retail season of the year, brands need to make their product information easy for both customers and LLMs to understand and verify,” said Truelogic managing partner  Bernard San Juan III . 
 “AI visibility is not only about capturing holiday demand. It is about building a digital presence that remains credible and discoverable as consumer search behavior changes.” — Ed: Corrie S. Narisma
